gloss: having few children; declining birthrate (in compounds)

definitions.gloss: having few children; few children; declining birthrate (in compounds)
definitions.explanation: {少|しょう} (few) + {子|し} (children). Appears almost exclusively as a bound element in compounds such as {少子化|しょうしか} (declining birthrate) and {少子高齢化|しょうしこうれいか} (declining birthrate combined with an aging society).

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{少子|しょうし}{化|か}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
{少子|しょうし}{高齢化|こうれいか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{社会問題|しゃかいもんだい}→社会問題：25686_shakaimondai⟧だ。
examples.english: The declining birthrate and aging population is a major social problem.

examples.japanese: {少子|しょうし}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{育児支援|いくじしえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拡充|かくじゅう}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As a measure against the declining birthrate, the government is expanding child-care support systems.

notes:
Bound combining form rather than a free-standing noun. Almost always appears as a prefix in compounds related to demographics.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{少子化|しょうしか}→少子化：04807_shoushika⟧: declining birthrate
- {少子|しょうし}{高齢化|こうれいか}: declining birthrate and aging society
- {少子|しょうし}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧: measures against the declining birthrate
- {少子|しょうし}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧: a society with few children

Not used as a standalone noun in everyday speech. The verb form 'to have few children' is expressed as {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧ rather than with {少子|しょうし}.
